description: This header file defines the HistoryViewModel class for the calculator application's MVVM architecture. It manages the history items, handles commands and events related to history, and interacts with the calculator manager.

classes.name: HistoryViewModel
classes.description: A sealed class implementing INotifyPropertyChanged, managing the calculator's history items, commands, and related events.

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new history item at the specified index.

methods.name: OnHideCommand
methods.description: Executes the hide command for the history view.

methods.name: ReloadHistory
methods.description: Reloads the history based on the current view mode.

methods.name: GetMaxItemSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of history items.
